component.name: Ferry
component.summary: Get the photos off your camera over Wi-Fi

description.p: Ferry copies photos and videos from your camera to your computer over Wi-Fi, without a cable or card reader. Turn on the camera's Wi-Fi the way you would for its phone app, join its network, and Ferry finds the camera, shows what is on the card and imports what's new into a folder.

ul.li: Remembers what it imported, so next time only new photos are offered
Folders by date, optional file renaming, and an optional upload to Immich
Works with a folder your photo app watches, such as digiKam, darktable or Shotwell
Fujifilm cameras can also send photos over your home Wi-Fi (PC AutoSave)

description.p: Tested on the Fujifilm X-T20 and, in an emulator, on more Fujifilm and Canon models. Other Fujifilm, Canon, GoPro, Olympus / OM System, Ricoh, Sony and Panasonic cameras with Wi-Fi are supported experimentally.
